automated_checks.note: Flags literal black borders around visibly brighter content only; intentional blurred-background padding (resize mode=blur_pad) and a deliberate fade-to-black ending (uniformly dark center too) will not trigger this.
HEURISTIC ONLY — a static/blank/low-contrast opening frame will fail this; 'strong hook' is a creative judgment call for the director either way.
If audio hasn't faded out by the last frames, ratio stays high — consider a fade-out or CTA card (add_cta_ending.py).

manual_review_required: Necklace / message card / gift box clearly visible and well-framed
General spelling/grammar of any text baked into the source footage itself (not our overlays)
Overall emotional tone matches 'premium, warm, intimate, cinematic' brand style
First 1-2 seconds are actually a strong scroll-stopping hook (heuristic above is a proxy, not a verdict)
